named-native-query.name: EsqAcctJpa.detailAcct
named-native-query.query: SELECT acc_pk AS "pk" ,acc_et_pk AS "kind" ,acc_id AS "name" ,acc_desc AS "desc" ,acc_ccy ,acc_balance ,acc_status ,acc_usr_pk ,TO_CHAR(acc_funded_dt, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS acc_funded_dt ,acct_neg_allowed_flg ,acc_change_no FROM esq_account JOIN esq_entity_path ON ep_pk = acc_pk WHERE acc_pk = CAST(:id AS bigint) AND ep_path LIKE :rootPath || '%'

named-native-query.name: EsqAcctJpa.detailAcctForUpdate
named-native-query.query: SELECT acc_pk AS "pk" ,acc_et_pk AS "kind" ,acc_id AS "name" ,acc_desc AS "desc" ,acc_ccy ,acc_balance ,acc_status ,acc_usr_pk ,TO_CHAR(acc_funded_dt, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS acc_funded_dt ,acct_neg_allowed_flg ,acc_change_no FROM esq_account JOIN esq_entity_path ON ep_pk = acc_pk WHERE acc_pk = CAST(:id AS bigint) AND acc_et_pk = :kind AND ep_path LIKE :rootPath || '%' FOR UPDATE

named-native-query.name: EsqAcctJpa.acctPath
named-native-query.query: SELECT ep_path FROM esq_entity_path WHERE ep_pk = CAST(:parentId AS bigint)

named-native-query.name: EsqAcctJpa.updateAcctBalance
named-native-query.query: UPDATE esq_account SET acc_balance = CAST(:balance AS numeric) ,acc_funded_dt = COALESCE(acc_funded_dt, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) ,acc_change_no = :changeNo ,acc_crl_id = :correlationId ,acc_req_id = :requestId ,acc_uid = :uid WHERE acc_pk = CAST(:id AS bigint)

named-native-query.name: EsqAcctJpa.deleteEntityPath
named-native-query.query: DELETE FROM esq_entity_path WHERE ep_pk = CAST(:pk AS bigint)

named-native-query.name: EsqAcctJpa.deleteAcct
named-native-query.query: DELETE FROM esq_account WHERE acc_pk = CAST(:id AS bigint)

named-native-query.name: EsqAcctJpa.updateAcct
named-native-query.query: UPDATE esq_account SET acc_desc = :desc ,acc_ccy = :ccy ,acc_status = :status ,acct_neg_allowed_flg = :negativeAllowed ,acc_change_no = :changeNo ,acc_crl_id = :correlationId ,acc_req_id = :requestId ,acc_uid = :uid WHERE acc_pk = CAST(:id AS bigint)
